instruction: By when should everything from my yesterday's amazon order arrive? Tell me the date in DD/MM format.
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so the goal only demands knowledge predicates plus task completion. The agent logs into Amazon, lists orders to locate the one placed yesterday (2023-05-17; a static (ordered-yesterday ?o) fact selects it), inspects that order to find the latest delivery date among all its items, and reports it in DD/MM format via supervisor.complete_task(answer=...). The order object on show-orders/complete-task and the date object on show-order are non-API record parameters bound at runtime.
